name: The Iridescent Oyster Moon Bazaar
description: A nocturnal fantasy market nestled inside glowing oyster shells on a dark reflective sea under a crescent moon.
prompt: A vast dark blue night sea with enormous pearlescent oyster shells glowing from within, tiny cozy market stalls woven into the shell folds, hanging lanterns made of floating pearl bubbles, bioluminescent jellyfish drifting between shells, warm lantern light reflecting on wet shells, dreamy fantasy harbor atmosphere, cinematic lighting, ultra detailed, no text, no logo, single image.
caption: When the moon opens a shell and lights a whole little city.
